title: Impulse Spend Regret by Hour
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn regretted=true
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| stats count as regretted_buys, sum(amount) as spend by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows the times of day when impulse spending is most likely to lead to regret.
value: Patterns of regretted spending are usually linked to fatigue, stress, or boredom rather than real need.
implementation: Tag regretted transactions in `index=personal`; summarize count and spend by purchase hour.
visualization: Hour-by-hour chart of regretted impulse spend.
grandmaExplanation: It measures what time of day you are most likely to buy something small and wish you had not later.
